title: C++: Move Semantics
description: Demonstrate move semantics with a custom vector-like class.

steps.title: Move Constructor and Assignment
steps.description: Create a `Buffer` class with a dynamically allocated int array. Implement move constructor and move assignment that transfer ownership instead of copying. Show that after a move, the source buffer's pointer is null.
hints: Buffer(Buffer&& other) : data(other.data), size(other.size) { other.data = nullptr; other.size = 0; }
Buffer& operator=(Buffer&& other) { if (this != &other) { delete[] data; data = other.data; size = other.size; other.data = nullptr; } return *this; }

verification.failureMessage: After move, source should have size 0
